name: Beluga Point Tidal Bore (Turnagain Arm), Alaska
quelle: Faustregel NWS/Alaska-Fuehrer: Beluga Point ~1:15 h nach NW Anchorage, Bore ab ~27 ft (8,2 m) Hub
text: Rule of thumb used by the US National Weather Service and local guides: the bore passes Beluga Point about 1 hour 15 minutes after low water at Anchorage, on tides with a range of about 8.2 m (27 ft) or more. Expect it within roughly 15 to 30 minutes of the time shown.
